mapper.sql: SELECT node.link_id AS trace_id, (array_agg(node.node_kind ORDER BY CASE node.node_kind WHEN 'span' THEN 1 WHEN 'run' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END) FILTER (WHERE node.is_entry))[1] AS entry_kind, (array_agg(node.entry_label ORDER BY CASE node.node_kind WHEN 'span' THEN 1 WHEN 'run' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END) FILTER (WHERE node.is_entry))[1] AS entry_label, min(node.start_time) AS start_time, max(node.end_time) AS end_time, max(node.duration) AS duration, max(node.app_id) AS app_id, max(node.app_name) AS app_name, max(node.session_id) AS session_id, max(node.user_id) AS user_id, max(node.model_name) AS model_name, count(*) FILTER (WHERE node.node_kind = 'run') AS run_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE node.node_kind = 'llm') AS llm_call_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE node.node_kind = 'span') AS span_count, coalesce(sum(node.total_tokens) FILTER (WHERE node.node_kind = 'llm'), 0)::bigint AS total_tokens, , (array_agg(node.error_message ORDER BY node.start_time) FILTER (WHERE node.node_status IN ('fail', 'failed')))[1] AS error_message FROM () node

CASE WHEN count(*) FILTER (WHERE node.node_status IN ('fail', 'failed')) > 0 THEN 'fail' WHEN count(*) FILTER (WHERE node.node_status IN ('running', 'waiting_approval', 'waiting_local')) > 0 THEN 'running' WHEN count(*) FILTER (WHERE node.node_status = 'cancelled') > 0 THEN 'cancelled' ELSE 'success' END AS status

choose.when: AND count(*) FILTER (WHERE node.node_status IN ('fail', 'failed')) = 0 AND count(*) FILTER (WHERE node.node_status IN ('running', 'waiting_approval', 'waiting_local')) > 0
